svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Millrace Station: map
svg.desc: Plan of Millrace Station: 4 decks stacked on one sheet, from Crown at the top to Seabed at the bottom. Each deck has a header with its department, every room carries its name, doors wear their department's colour, and stairs, ladders, a lift and cable risers are marked. The same rooms are listed below the picture.
svg.text: 4 decks stacked, the top deck first. 60 rooms. Floors and doors are coloured by the department that holds the key.

g.text: Command, the watch and the law; the living rooms: quarters, mess and bar, kitchen and botany
Medical and science, the chapel, the Mining Sub and the disposal plant
Engineering: the power chain, the workshops, air works, the stores and the Moon Pool
The turbine fields on their walkway under the Moon Pool; the mine site lies further off

svg.text: Lift (a cart lift to every station deck)
Moon pool (a diver's way to the seabed and back)
